bio.text: Simcha Eichenstein was elected on November 6, 2018, to represent New York's 48th Assembly District, which includes Borough Park, Kensington and Midwood in Brooklyn.
On the first day of the 2023 legislative session he was appointed Assistant Majority Whip of the Assembly.
Before his election he served on New York City Mayor Bill de Blasio's legislative affairs team in Albany and on the mayor's senior intergovernmental staff at City Hall.
